name: Viking Zombie Lord
body:
VIKING ZOMBIE LORD CR 3

XP 800
Human (viking) zombie lord warrior 3
NE Medium undead
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 18 (+6 armor, +2 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 33 (5 HD; 2d8+3d10+8)
Fort +2, Ref +3, Will +4
Defensive Abilities channel resistance +4; DR 5/slashing; Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee battleaxe +9 (1d8+11/×3) or slam +8 (1d6+11)

TACTICS

During Combat Taking advantage of Furious Focus, the creature uses Power Attack (included in stats) at all times, only taking the -2 penalty to attack rolls on any additional attacks they make in a round, such as attacks of opportunity. They use Cleave whenever two enemies are adjacent, and attempt to demoralize opponents if they cannot engage them in melee.

Morale The creature fights until they or their enemies are destroyed.

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 15, Con —, Int 9, Wis 10, Cha 8
Base Atk +4; CMB +7; CMD 19
Feats Cleave, Furious Focus, Power Attack, ToughnessB, Weapon Focus (battleaxe)
Skills Intimidate +7, Perception +8, Ride +1, Swim +2
Languages Common, Skall
Gear chainmail, battleaxe
